profile.name: xArm机械臂
profile.description: 一款可编程多轴机械臂，可按G代码或预定义路径执行运动任务。在实验室中常用于自动化取放、样品转运、定位与重复轨迹操作等流程。
profile.description_en: A programmable multi-axis robotic arm that can execute motion tasks from G-code or predefined paths. In laboratories, it is commonly used for automated pick-and-place, sample transfer, positioning, and repeatable motion workflows.

registry.name: UFACTORY Gcode
registry.description: UFACTORY Gcode Client 客户端 气相色谱仪是由UFACTORY (xArm)生产的机械臂，主要功能包括关闭、执行、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
